summary: Opt in to certified native agent rows and bounded deltas on the existing collection socket.

replay.detail: Explicit installation extracts the complete receiver-bound source in indexed pages of at most 128 rows and 1 MiB, then catches up captured mutations and publishes a fresh Installer namespace. Compatible reopening after a raw capture gap or fenced source performs actual native graph replay before fresh bounded extraction; an old root cannot clear the fence. Ordinary live maintenance repairs affected keys and captured deadlines rather than rebuilding full agent windows.

schema.detail: The opt-in constructor installs private source capture, namespace, row journal, producer boundary and scheduling tables and triggers. The shared schema version is unchanged. The source fingerprint binds the current schema and claim registry, receiver and eligibility policy. Source schema or binding drift refuses agent reads independently of registry readiness.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule version or fleet digest change. Normal checkpoint state writers use the shared managed transaction hooks; raw checkpoint writes retain the capture fence.

compatibility.detail: ST3_AGENT_COLLECTION_IVM=1 selects complete agent rows on the existing collections v0 socket. Collection names, JSON frames, generated clients and subscription bounds are unchanged. Snapshot, changes and resync retain the existing authorization and reconnect rules. Unsupported or incomplete source evidence produces unavailable/resync rather than legacy row fallback. Other collections retain their existing readers.

downtime.detail: Populated installation and deployed Linux/macOS startup times have not been measured on this source. Open-time native backlog projection or raw-gap replay runs synchronously before daemon startup. After opening, the native Store serves while bounded agent namespace installation is pending or refused. Installer limits are explicit: 1,000,000 extracted rows, 128 rows/1 MiB per page, 16,384 rows/16 MiB pending journal, 1 s callback and 1 h lifetime. Historical inventories do not establish that the current populated source fits these limits.

manual.detail: Set ST3_AGENT_COLLECTION_IVM=1 only for the explicitly selected native agent source. No separate client readiness command or manual SQL surgery is required. Observe source refusal diagnostics; changed receiver, schema, fingerprint or epoch needs a separately qualified source lifecycle. The default constructor retains its existing route.

recovery.detail: Same-binding recovery preserves source epoch, revision and graph identity, discards only the bounded fixed pre-recovery capture range covered by the new baseline, reclaims unattached namespaces and republishes a fresh namespace. Interrupted recovery remains unavailable. Disabling the opt-in returns to the existing native collection route; restoring an incompatible binding never adopts prior readiness or producer evidence.
